title: The Focused Beam
cue: One task. Ten minutes. Begin.
action: Pick one useful task. Work on it for ten minutes. Each time you drift, return to that task.
explanation: The Focused Beam is illustrated with its own lighthouse artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: The Space Between
cue: Pause. Exhale. Choose.
action: Before one reactive reply today, pause, let out a gentle breath, and choose what to say.
explanation: The Space Between is illustrated with its own floating stones artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Intentional Unlock
cue: When I unlock, I choose my purpose.
action: Before opening an app, say why you unlocked your phone. If there is no purpose, put it down.
explanation: Intentional Unlock is illustrated with its own purpose portal artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: The First Two Minutes
cue: Make the first step small enough to start.
action: Choose a task you have avoided. Do its smallest first step for two minutes.
explanation: The First Two Minutes is illustrated with its own small staircase artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Thought Is Not Fact
cue: Notice the thought. Check the evidence.
action: Write down a troubling thought. Identify a fact that supports it and a fact that complicates it.
explanation: Thought Is Not Fact is illustrated with its own thought and stone artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Return to Now
cue: Feel your feet. Notice what is here.
action: At three natural pauses, feel your feet and name three things you can see.
explanation: Return to Now is illustrated with its own grounded island artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Name the Feeling
cue: Name it before you act.
action: Name a strong feeling in plain words. Then choose one useful next action.
explanation: Name the Feeling is illustrated with its own named facets artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: The Slow Exhale
cue: Let the next exhale be gentle and unhurried.
action: Take three comfortable breaths with unhurried exhales. Return to normal breathing if uncomfortable.
explanation: The Slow Exhale is illustrated with its own quiet feather artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: One Next Action
cue: Write the next action. Do only that.
action: Write one action beginning with a verb. Do that action before planning the rest.
explanation: One Next Action is illustrated with its own one golden path artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Close the Loop
cue: Choose a finish line. Reach it.
action: Define what finished means for one small task. Complete that version before adding more.
explanation: Close the Loop is illustrated with its own needle and thread artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Active Recall
cue: Close the page. Recall one idea.
action: After studying, close the page and explain one idea from memory. Reopen it to check.
explanation: Active Recall is illustrated with its own memory book artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Space the Practice
cue: Review tomorrow. Return next week.
action: Review one idea today. Schedule a short review for tomorrow and next week.
explanation: Space the Practice is illustrated with its own spaced mobile artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Learn from Error
cue: Find the error. Change one step.
action: Identify a step that led to one mistake. Change that step and try again.
explanation: Learn from Error is illustrated with its own kintsugi bowl artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Protect Your Attention
cue: Silence one distraction before you begin.
action: Silence one notification source and move one distraction out of reach before focusing.
explanation: Protect Your Attention is illustrated with its own protected candle artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Rest Is a Rhythm
cue: Choose a bedtime. Begin winding down.
action: Choose tonight's wind-down time. Dim your environment and stop one stimulating activity then.
explanation: Rest Is a Rhythm is illustrated with its own resting mountains artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Move the Body
cue: Stand up. Take a short walk.
action: Take a short comfortable walk at a natural break, or choose movement suitable for your body.
explanation: Move the Body is illustrated with its own a moving human artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: The Kinder Voice
cue: Speak to yourself as you would to a friend.
action: Rewrite a self-critical sentence as advice you would give a friend. Use that advice.
explanation: The Kinder Voice is illustrated with its own a kind embrace artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Compare Less
cue: Choose your own next step.
action: When comparison distracts you, take one step toward your own goal.
explanation: Compare Less is illustrated with its own two own gardens artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: The Worry Window
cue: Write the worry. Choose when to revisit it.
action: Write a non-urgent worry down and schedule ten minutes to revisit it. Handle urgent practical issues now.
explanation: The Worry Window is illustrated with its own worry lantern artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Make Room
cue: Let the feeling be here. Choose your action.
action: Notice a difficult feeling without demanding it disappear. Take a small action that matters to you.
explanation: Make Room is illustrated with its own room for a feeling artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Check the Story
cue: What happened? What am I adding?
action: Describe an upsetting event using observable facts. Write your interpretation separately.
explanation: Check the Story is illustrated with its own check the prism artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Control the Next Step
cue: Act on what is yours to change.
action: List one thing you can influence. Spend ten minutes acting on it.
explanation: Control the Next Step is illustrated with its own next step compass artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Respond with Care
cue: Read again. Reply after a pause.
action: Reread a tense message after a pause. Make one edit that improves clarity or care.
explanation: Respond with Care is illustrated with its own letter of care artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Listen First
cue: Understand before you answer.
action: Summarise what you heard and check your understanding before giving advice in one conversation.
explanation: Listen First is illustrated with its own listening shell artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Set the Boundary
cue: Say what you can do. Say what you cannot.
action: Use a clear sentence: I can do this, but I cannot do that. Offer a realistic alternative if helpful.
explanation: Set the Boundary is illustrated with its own a gentle boundary artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Notice the Good
cue: Name one specific thing you appreciate.
action: Name one thing you appreciate and why. If it involves someone, consider telling them yourself.
explanation: Notice the Good is illustrated with its own ordinary beauty artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Repeat the Cue
cue: After my daily cue, I do one small action.
action: Make a plan: After [daily routine], I will [small action]. Practise it at that cue today.
explanation: Repeat the Cue is illustrated with its own cue and motion artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Change the Environment
cue: Put the helpful choice within reach.
action: Put a useful object where you will use it: a book, walking shoes, or a water bottle.
explanation: Change the Environment is illustrated with its own the helpful bridge artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Begin Again
cue: A missed day is a cue to return.
action: Resume a paused habit with its smallest useful version. Return without trying to catch up.
explanation: Begin Again is illustrated with its own beginning again artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.

title: Practise the Person
cue: Choose one action that matches your values.
action: Choose a value such as care, learning, or honesty. Take one concrete action that expresses it.
explanation: Practise the Person is illustrated with its own the person you practise artwork. Let the image bring the short cue back to mind when it would be useful.
